comment: Board card state — the single source of truth for production progress (stage + priority order; top of list = next up). Six stages: backlog → sourced → designed → built → proven → live. A play card advances a stage only on a Director confirm. The top-level `ready` list flags slugs whose work is done and awaiting the Director's confirm (separate from stage). `graduated` holds play slugs explicitly moved out of active stages; `graduatedAt` stores their date-only graduation dates. `cards` holds Testing/Improvement/Bug work orders with their own open/in-progress/done/wont-do status, independent of play stage; terminal work carries terminalAt and may carry archived and pinned, with archive membership derived by readers. Agents edit this file directly; the Board page persists here.

cards.detail: The first real node-maker, and your opening real build. Integrate + skin the Vocabulary prototype into the viewer so it emits named cards on shelves, bound to one lexicon and the canonical Brick-0 (#328) frontmatter schema. Seed from the Studio FoH/BoH read you already have (docs/.../rebuilding-the-library/test-scan-03-studio) — do NOT wait on the Codebase Scanner. Parallel-safe; its schema dependency is already ruled. STEPS: (1) fix the vocabulary->lexicon rename so the explorer build reads the real data; (2) reconcile the 9-field frontmatter to the canonical Brick-0 schema; (3) build the missing elicitation form and skin it into the viewer; (4) produce a first batch of named Studio cards on shelves from the existing read.
cards.title: Phase 3 · Name the Things (Vocabulary)

cards.detail: Raise Skeleton + Surface to peer Vocabulary: emit library-form structural edges (the containment tree + the one core path) as [[wikilinks]] bound to the lexicon. Sufficiency bar: spine complete, periphery deferred. Blocked by Name the Things (edges reference named nouns). STEPS: (1) retarget Skeleton output from prose to library-form nodes+edges bound to the lexicon; (2) emit the containment tree + the one core path as wikilinks; (3) stop at spine-complete, defer periphery.
cards.title: Phase 3 · Lay the Shelves (Skeleton + Surface)

cards.detail: Stitch Back-of-House -> Front-of-House -> Confirm Gate -> Empty Library View into ONE end-to-end loop on the Studio target, now fed by the real node/edge tooling instead of a hand-stubbed bundle. The Director's 'yes, these are my words; yes, this is where things live' gate. The per-play testing campaigns for these three plays already exist as separate cards — this is the stitch goal. Blocked by Name the Things + Lay the Shelves. STEPS: (1) feed the empty-library loop from Vocabulary + Skeleton output, not a hand-stubbed bundle; (2) run BoH -> FoH -> Confirm end to end on the Studio; (3) land a library.confirmed Ledger event for the Studio bundle.
cards.title: Phase 3 · Confirm the Empty Library (end-to-end)

cards.detail: Change the atomizer's input from 'a doc' to 'the confirmed shelves + lexicon': triage slots concepts onto confirmed shelves in confirmed words; a concept with no shelf becomes a gap report, never an invented category. The self-hosting flip — author THROUGH make-a-play only if it's Proven, else hand-author and bank the re-make (escape hatch). Blocked by Confirm the Empty Library. STEPS: (1) re-point input to confirmed stubs + lexicon prefLabel, no-shelf -> gap report; (2) migrate ax2->ax and re-prove on the conan/sam/bridget/solomon evals; (3) if make-a-play is Proven author through it, else hand-author and bank the re-make.
cards.title: Phase 3 · Re-point the Atomizer (#350)

cards.detail: Run the whole pipeline on Playmaker Studio itself -> the Studio's own product library. The output is a real artifact, not a test fixture. That fact is the proof. Blocked by Confirm + Re-point. STEPS: (1) run the full pipeline end-to-end on the Studio target; (2) produce the Studio's own product library as a real artifact.
cards.title: Phase 3 · Fill the Studio's Shelves (the dogfood)

cards.detail: The Director walks the produced library + the build experience. Findings become the Phase-3 fix-list, dispatched through the same machine as Phases 1-2. This is where 'tune the card-making process' actually happens before pointing the pipeline at Alexandria (Phase 4). Blocked by Fill the Studio's Shelves. STEPS: (1) walk the produced Studio library and the build experience; (2) turn findings into the Phase-3 fix-list and dispatch them.
cards.title: Phase 3 · Walk the Studio's Library (tune the process)

cards.detail: Deliberately deferred so the opening sprint stays narrow. None of these block the library chain — improve, don't churn.
